summary.text: Jocelyn Fry is the Libertarian candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the Republican incumbent is Les Eaves.
A consultant, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a mother who is passionate about liberty and peace.

paragraphs.text: Jocelyn Fry advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running as the only opposition to a multi-term incumbent and that she wants voters dissatisfied with the status quo to have another choice.
She listed criminal justice reform, free and fair elections and reining in government spending among her policy interests, and said she was nominated by the Libertarian Party of Arkansas.
